definitions.gloss: nightlife; going out at night for fun; late-night entertainment
definitions.explanation: Going out to enjoy oneself at night, such as visiting bars, clubs, or entertainment districts. Often implies staying out until late.

examples.japanese: {夜遊|よあそ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I enjoy going out at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜遊|よあそ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm worried because my son has been going out at night more often lately.

examples.japanese: {学生時代|がくせいじだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{夜遊|よあそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a student, I often went out at night with friends.

notes:
{夜遊|よあそ}び refers to going out to enjoy entertainment at night — visiting bars, clubs, karaoke, or entertainment districts.

WORD FORMATION: {夜|よ} (night) + ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧ (play, amusement)

USAGE:
Can carry a mildly negative nuance, especially when used by parents or authority figures to describe someone staying out late. Among peers, it is more neutral and simply means having fun at night.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜遊|よあそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go out at night
- {夜遊|よあそ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to go out too much at night
- {夜遊|よあそ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧: to like nightlife
- {夜遊|よあそ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to head out for a night on the town

ASPECT (ている):
{夜遊|よあそ}び⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ means "is out partying" (ongoing activity) or "has been going out at night regularly" (habitual action).
